name: Typst Preview
description: Edit Typst beside a live preview using the current Orca workspace and its existing host connection.

settings.title: Tinymist executable
settings.description: Path to tinymist on the compilation host. Supports ~/ paths.

settings.title: Additional font directories
settings.description: Optional Typst font path on the compilation host.

settings.title: Local package directory
settings.description: Optional override; normally Typst discovers your local packages.

settings.title: Node.js executable on workspace host
settings.description: Optional override for remote workspaces. Node.js 22 or newer is required.

settings.title: Export PDF beside source
settings.description: While Preview is open, compile saved source to a PDF in the same directory.
